greeting.text: The wind carried your scent before your footsteps did. You seek answers, young one. They all do.

responses.text: What do you know about the Aether corruption?
Can you teach me about herbs?

shop.text: Potions, salves, tinctures. Each one a small miracle brewed from root and rain. Choose wisely.

responses.text: What do you recommend for a new adventurer?

browse_potions.text: Healing draughts, antidotes, elixirs of vigor. The forest provides, if you know where to look.

browse_ingredients.text: Raw materials for those who walk the alchemist's path. Or perhaps you have herbs to sell?

responses.text: Teach me which herbs to gather.

recommendation.text: Three healing draughts and an antidote. Thornwood's creatures carry poisons that rot flesh in hours.

poison_knowledge.text: The corrupted beasts weep a venom that wasn't there before. New poison, born from tainted Aether. Troubling.

custom_brew.text: Bring me the components and I shall weave them into something greater. Alchemy is merely patience made liquid.

aether_corruption.text: The world breathes Aether like you breathe air. But something poisons the breath. The land sickens from within.

responses.text: How long has this been happening?

corruption_source.text: A wound in the earth, where something was sealed long ago. Seals do not last forever. Nothing does.

responses.text: This is connected to the goblins, isn't it?

wound_location.text: Deep in Thornwood, where the trees grow silent and the birds refuse to sing. You will know it by the silence.

investigation_warning.text: Some have. None returned unchanged. The corruption whispers, you see. It offers power. Most cannot refuse.

elara_reassurance.text: Fear is the mind's shield against foolishness. Keep it close. But do not let it anchor you in place.

sealed_thing.text: Old hunger. Old malice. It has many names across many ages. This generation calls it nothing, for they have forgotten.

responses.text: How do you know all this?

hollow_mention.text: You know that name? Interesting. Be careful where you speak it. Some words are heard by things that listen in the dark.

responses.text: The stranger in town mentioned it.

hollow_details.text: A pact made in desperation, an age ago. Power given for a price no one remembered to pay. The debt comes due.

stranger_knowledge.text: The hooded one? They carry secrets like open wounds. Trust carefully. Not all who oppose the dark serve the light.

trust_assessment.text: I trust that they fear what is coming. Fear makes honest allies. For a time.

corruption_cure.text: A river cannot be cleaned at its mouth. You must walk to the source. But first, you must survive the walk.

preparation_help.text: Bring me moonpetal and ashroot from the forest edge. I will brew a ward against the corruption's whisper.

gather_accepted.text: Moonpetal blooms at dusk near running water. Ashroot clings to dead trees. Hurry. The corruption spreads.

corruption_timeline.text: A trickle for decades. A stream for years. Now a flood. This land has perhaps one season before the rot takes hold.

responses.text: One season? That's not much time.
What happens if it takes hold?

urgency.text: No. It is not. That is why every sword and every soul in Hearthholm matters now. Including yours.

responses.text: Tell me how to fight this.
I won't waste the time we have.

worst_case.text: The living flee. The dead rise. The forest becomes a maw that swallows everything. It has happened before.

historical_event.text: I was young then. Another forest, another age. We stopped it, but the cost... I still hear their names on the wind.

goblin_connection.text: Creatures of instinct flee poison. Goblins are not fleeing into Hearthholm. They are being driven.

responses.text: So killing them won't solve the real problem.

deeper_truth.text: Cutting weeds does not kill the root. But it buys time to find the root. Both matter.

herb_teaching.text: Silverleaf soothes wounds. Bittercap cures poison. Thornberry numbs pain. The forest is a garden, if you have eyes to see.

responses.text: Can I sell you herbs I find?

herb_locations.text: Silverleaf near streams. Bittercap under old oaks. Thornberry along cliff edges. And never pick under a new moon.

moon_warning.text: Herbs absorb moonlight like roots drink water. Without it, they hold only bitterness. Timing is alchemy's secret.

dangerous_herbs.text: Nightbloom kills in a swallow. Witch-ivy burns the skin for days. Learn what not to touch before you reach for anything.

responses.text: How do I tell them apart?

herb_identification.text: Smell before you touch. Touch before you taste. And never taste if it smells of copper or sweetness together.

fog_knowledge.text: The fog. Yes. A symptom, not the sickness. Aether bleeds from the wound like heat from a fever. The land trembles.

fog_remedy.text: I can brew wards against its effects, but I cannot heal a wound I cannot reach. That task needs younger legs.

responses.text: Tell me more about the corruption.

about_elara.text: Seven centuries of watching mortals repeat their mistakes. And yet, each generation surprises me. Hope is stubborn.

elara_age.text: Elven years pass like water through fingers. I am old even by my people's measure. Wisdom is a slow harvest.

why_stay.text: Because last time, I ran. I will not make that mistake twice. Some debts can only be paid by standing still.

end_shop.text: May your path be lit by more than starlight, child. Return when the forest yields its gifts.

end_ominous.text: Walk carefully where the silence grows thick. And remember: not every voice in the dark is an enemy.

end.text: The wind shifts. Go now, and listen to what the world tells you. It speaks, if you are quiet enough.
